notes.title: New Soundtrack and X-mas event returns!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Sorry for the huge delay between updates. I was having engine issues that were making it very difficult to test and compile builds. These issues have now been resolved and the game has been moved to Unity 2022. Updates should now be much more frequent.

This update adds an additional soundtrack to the game featuring traditional Japanese music composed specifically for Samurai Slaughter House by Gorilla Chain.

Sword unstabbing has been improved. Swords will now pull out realistically but should not be difficult to remove as they were in the past.

Also the x-mas event is back!

notes.title: Spanish Localization
notes.content:
Hey everyone! This patch adds Spanish localization and also fixes a few bugs.

Another update is coming soon with new content!

notes.title: 04/16/2023 - Version 0.6.4460
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Small update here. This should fix occurrences of users getting crashes when having the mask maker in their party.

Also updated sword so that they are easier to pull out of enemies. I'm still not 100% happy with this mechanic, so this will get another update soon.

Have also been working on adding more enemy types to the game, so that update will be coming soon along with some other cool things I have in store.

Enjoy!

 - Justin "Tab" Rosete

notes.title: Easy Unsheathing Mode
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I received a lot of feedback that people were having difficulty with the iado sheathing/unsheathing of the katana so I've add an Easy Sheath Mode.

When this is turned on, you can grab your sword to instantly remove it from the sheath or tap it to the mouth of your sheath to instantly put it away.

If you haven't already joined the game's Discord channel, I would definitely recommend it if you'd like to leave feedback! I'm quite active in it and take in to consideration all the feedback I receive.

Have a good weekend!

Justin "Tab" Rosete

notes.title: Correct build uploaded!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

As some of you may know, I am a one person team trying to run a company and develop game by myself while doing other work as well to make sure I can pay my bills.

Excuses aside I made a major huge mistake. Due to me not understanding Steams content pipeline system, I accidentally launched the game using a build that was uploaded in June of 2022 and was never meant to be seen by the public.

I just uploaded a new build today. I hope everyone who was disappointed with the game they downloaded at launch will give it another chance.

I'll be continuing to update the game regularly just as I did before it came to Steam.
Expect a consistent string of improvements and new content over the next year.

I thank everyone who supported the game at launch and hope you enjoy the updates to come!

 - Justin "Tab" Rosete

notes.title: Correct build uploaded
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I apologize for the status of the launch build.
While the game is still very much in early access, due to a misunderstanding of Steam's build system, I accidentally launched with a build from almost a year ago.

The changes are so vast that I can't even list them all down to make proper patch notes.
